newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK CUT CONSUMER LOAN RATES 100-150BPS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK CUT CONSUMER LOAN RATES 100-150BPS.

text.p: Greek Xiosbank said in a statement that it cut its consumer loans by 100 to 150 basis points taking advantage of the satisfactory performance of its loan portfolio.

The Xios mortgage rate was cut by a point to 16 percent, mortgage loan of reduced installments by a point to 9.0 percent, repair loans by 100 to 150 basis points depending on the type, consumer polydanio loan by a point to 23 percent and Xiosbank Visa card by a point to 26.50 percent.
It also cut its business credit lending rate by half a point to 19.75 percent for the week October 7 to October 13.
XiosAlma savings account offers an annual return of 12.40 percent for the same week with a monthly payment of interest. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
